question:
Select the most appropriate option to substitute the underlined segment in the given sentence.

The ship launched out on a __journey by water or sea__ of discovery.
solution:
The correct answer is: **Option 1**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"rendezvous"** means a meeting at an agreed time and place, typically between two people. (मुलाकात)

 
 
• **Example: **They planned a secret rendezvous at the park to discuss their plans.
 
 
 
• **"Voyage" **refers to a long journey involving travel by sea or in space. (समुद्री यात्रा)
 
 
• **Example: **The ship embarked on a voyage to discover new lands.
 
 
 
• Hence, we can infer that the correct word to replace "a journey by water or sea of discovery" is **'voyage'**.

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 1**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Verso** (पुस्तक के बाएँ पृष्ठ): The left-hand page of an open book, or the back of a loose document.

 
 
• **Example:** The verso of the manuscript contained additional notes and illustrations.
 
 
 
• **Vespers** (संध्या प्रार्थना): A service of evening prayer in the Divine Office of the Western Christian Church.
 
 
• **Example: **They attended vespers every evening at the local church.
